item.text: I’m locating the relevant table or sentence in the Treasury Bulletin text and will extract the latest per-capita currency-and-coin figure directly from the document.
`rg` isn’t available here, so I’m using `grep` to find the circulation table and its most recent per-capita value.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'grep -n -i -E "per capita|currency and coin|currency|coin in circulation|circulation" /mnt/data/LSF/data/officeqa/text/treasury_bulletin_2025_03.txt | head -n 50'
